# Shh Aesthetics & Wellness

> Mobile, nurse practitioner-led aesthetics and wellness practice serving Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Naples and the rest of Lee, Charlotte and Collier counties in Southwest Florida. Kelly, a licensed nurse practitioner, provides natural-looking Botox, Dysport, dermal fillers, skin care and medical weight management at clients' homes. Consultations are free.

## Key facts

- Business name: Shh Aesthetics & Wellness (legal name: SHH AESTHETICS AND WELLNESS LLC)
- Tagline: Beauty is our little secret
- Provider: Kelly, licensed nurse practitioner (NP). Kelly performs every consultation and treatment.
- Model: Mobile practice. Kelly travels to the client's home; there is no office or waiting room.
- Service area: Lee, Charlotte and Collier counties, Florida, including Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero, Lehigh Acres, Sanibel, Marco Island, Punta Gorda and Port Charlotte.
- Consultation: Free, at the client's home, with no obligation.
- Appointment length: Usually 1 to 2 hours, depending on the treatment.
- Approach: Conservative, natural-looking results. No upselling. Every plan starts with the client's health history.

## Treatments

- Injectables: Botox and Dysport, dermal fillers, lip enhancement, jawline contouring
- Skin care: peptide therapy, custom home skin care routines
- Wellness: medically guided weight management with regular check-ins

## Common questions

- Does Shh Aesthetics come to your home? Yes. Every consultation and treatment happens at the client's home.
- Is the consultation free? Yes.
- Who performs treatments? Kelly, a licensed nurse practitioner.
- How long does Botox last? As a general guide, three to four months; fillers often last longer. Results vary by person.
- Is everyone a candidate? No. Some health conditions, medications and pregnancy rule out certain treatments, which is why every plan starts with a health history review.
